stolen-at-hauler.text: When Defeated: Choose an opponent. For this phase, they may play this unit from its owner's discard pile for free.
stolen-at-hauler.rules:
“Play for free” ignores all resource costs, including the aspect penalty, but not other additional costs.
An opponent can't play Stolen AT-Hauler if they can't take an action to play it, such as if they have already taken the initiative or the unit is defeated during the regroup phase.
